sourceControl.note: Community head above is the review base before this readiness documentation series; final production replay must pin a later accepted final-integrated-main commit and must not infer a live branch head from this field.

requiredContent: staging pg_net SQL only under supabase/staging
all three WEP Preset production migrations
WEP Preset artifact + retention Edge Functions
no production migration that creates a staging-named Preset bucket
current Product approval / Privacy-Legal pending machine state

storageRecoveryProvider.requirement: private rollback-independent copy, <=24h RPO, target 7d copy retention, restore drill, access audit/encryption

requirements: distinct Supabase project; never reuse staging ref
target region ap-northeast-1 unless user deliberately changes it
COMMUNITY_MEDIA_BUCKET explicitly configured and not staging-named
WEP_PRESET_ARTIFACT_BUCKET explicitly configured and not staging-named
new production publishable key; no staging key reuse
production secrets/tokens generated independently; no staging secret reuse
executionPrerequisites: Privacy/Legal provider-binding review complete enough for production configuration

rules: link only the exact approved production project
replay only reviewed supabase/migrations from the pinned final-integrated-main commit
do not import or copy staging migration history
fail on duplicate versions or staging-only migration names
record exact source commit and resulting migration list
after replay, verify schema/function/cron prerequisites before exposing traffic
direct production DDL is forbidden; use forward-fix migrations

edgeFunctions.acceptance: Production inventory must equal/contain only the reviewed production allowlist for this subsystem and contain none of the denylist.

rules: never copy staging secret values into production
never record secret values in repository/evidence
rotate one dependency at a time: create new -> configure consumer -> smoke -> revoke old
record only secret name, rotation timestamp, operator and result
re-run dependent worker smoke after each rotation

steps: reconcile Recovery Deletion Ledger before any public access
never promote if deletion reconciliation is incomplete
restore media and Preset object copies into non-public quarantine buckets
never overwrite primary production buckets during the drill
reconcile deletion ledger and remove objects belonging to deleted accounts where applicable
verify signed-read authorization only after reconciliation
record missing/orphan object counts and RTO
block promotion on mismatch or deletion-ledger failure

nonGoals: do not rerun the full primary Community browser suite
do not rerun Scene Preset vertical
do not rerun ArtifactBlob retention E2E
do not exercise persistent DDV world/save Apply
minimumChecks: production URL/publishable key resolve to production project only
designated production QA user can sign in and query self
one private Community work remains non-public
one public QA work is discoverable after publication
authorized media/Preset signed read succeeds from private production buckets
staging-only Edge Function slugs are absent
Delete Account is not exercised as routine smoke unless a disposable production QA account is intentionally allocated

acceptance: review every RLS INFO/WARN against intentional server-only boundary
if production uses Supabase Pro or above, enable Leaked Password Protection; do not carry the Free staging exception into Pro production
if production uses Free, leaked-password-protection unavailability must remain an explicitly accepted compensated limitation and the 15-character/recent-auth/revocation controls remain required
record production advisor output without secrets

requiredFinalEvidence: pinned final-integrated-main commit and verifier PASS
distinct production project ref (recorded only after user-authorized creation)
function allowlist and denylist absence PASS
backup mechanism + DB restore drill PASS
Storage backup mechanism + restore drill PASS

prohibitedBeforeReleaseStage: create Cloudflare R2 production recovery bucket
